scripts.build:app: npm run build && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer
scripts.format: prettier --check electron src/renderer vite.config.ts eslint.config.js forge.config.cjs scripts/rename-dmg.mjs scripts/check-node-version.mjs
scripts.format:write: prettier --write electron src/renderer vite.config.ts eslint.config.js forge.config.cjs scripts/rename-dmg.mjs scripts/check-node-version.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run build:preload && concurrently -k -s first "vite" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron dist/compiled/electron/main.js"
scripts.package:dmg: node scripts/check-node-version.mjs && rm -rf out release/Soroeru-*.dmg && npm run build:app && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 npx playwright install chromium && electron-forge make --platform=darwin && node scripts/rename-dmg.mjs
scripts.release:check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run poc -- check-egress && npm run poc -- check-persistence && npm run poc -- check-bypass
